title: Keyword Research For Yoga Retreats: Free Guide

facts.fact: The guide is organised into nine numbered steps, from Step 1 (start with your ideal retreat guest) to Step 9 (measure what's working and refine your approach).
facts.quote: Step 9: Measure what's working and refine your approach

facts.fact: The guide recommends writing down a starting list of 5-10 phrases that ideal retreat guests might search for.
facts.quote: Write down 5-10 phrases you think your ideal guests might search for.
